Package gui

Class ManageOrders_GUI

java.lang.Object
gui.ManageOrders_GUI
public class ManageOrders_GUI extends Object
Unified Controller for Managing Reservations (Admin View). Handles table display, manual creation, and administrative updates. Styled with a dark theme to match the AddReservation screen.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the controller class. Sets up the admin reservations table, date picker restrictions, user ID listener, combo box styling, and guests spinner. Also requests opening hours and table data from the server.

    • updateMaxCapacity

      public void updateMaxCapacity(int realMax)
      Updates the maximum capacity for the guests spinner based on real-time table data
      Parameters:
      realMax - The actual maximum capacity calculated from current table configurations.

    • fillUserDetails

      public void fillUserDetails(UserRecord user)
      Fills in user details (Phone and Email) based on the retrieved UserRecord. If no user is found, clears the fields and shows an alert.
      Parameters:
      user - The UserRecord object containing user details, or null if not found.

    • loadDynamicHours

      public void loadDynamicHours(LocalDate selectedDate, String timeToSelect)
      Loads available time slots dynamically based on the selected date and restaurant hours.
      Parameters:
      selectedDate - The date for which to load available time slots.
      timeToSelect - An optional time string to pre-select in the ComboBox.

    • refreshAdminData

      public void refreshAdminData()
      Refreshes the admin reservation data by requesting the latest from the server.

    • updateAdminUI

      public void updateAdminUI(List<Reservation> list)
      Updates the admin UI with the latest list of reservations.
      Parameters:
      list - The list of reservations to display.

    • showSuccessAlert

      public void showSuccessAlert(int code)
      Displays a success alert when a reservation is created successfully.
      Parameters:
      code - The confirmation code of the newly created reservation.

    • showUpdateSuccessAlert

      public void showUpdateSuccessAlert()
      Displays a success alert when a reservation is updated successfully.

    • showNoTableAlert

      public void showNoTableAlert(LocalDateTime suggested)
      Displays an alert when no tables are available for the selected date/time. Offers to update the form with a suggested alternative time if provided.
      Parameters:
      suggested - The suggested LocalDateTime for the nearest available slot, or null if none.

    • refreshHours

      public void refreshHours()
      Called by Client_Controller when opening hours change via broadcast. Refreshes the time slots if a date is selected.
